Home / Museum Ship Reports / Wuhan Museum Ships

Location: 16 Shanghai Rd, 客运港 Jiang'An, Wuhan, Hubei, China, 430021

Visited: 23 December 2019

These photos were taken a km or two away from the wet market where things were starting to kick off with COVID (although I didn't know about all that until a couple of weeks later). The main museum was closed for winter, but there were a couple of Luda class destroyers there, a Shanghai class patrol boat and a submarine. Along the river there was a smaller old patrol boat which was effectively hauled up onto the river bank as a playground for children, and then a bit further along another boat which was apparently famous because Mao had boarded her at some point.
